description.content: Writes a single data record into an Amazon Kinesis data stream. You must specify the name or ARN of the stream that captures, stores, and transports the data, a partition key, and the data blob itself. The partition key is used by Kinesis Data Streams to distribute data across shards. Kinesis Data Streams segregates the data records that belong to a stream into multiple shards, using the partition key associated with each data record to determine the shard to which a given data record belongs.

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is a massively scalable and durable real-time data streaming service. It can continuously capture gigabytes of data per second from hundreds of thousands of sources such as website clickstreams, database event streams, financial transactions, social media feeds, IT logs, and location-tracking events. The Kinesis Data Streams API uses a JSON protocol over HTTP with the X-Amz-Target header to specify the action.
